# Lorcán O'Neill

> Personal website of Lorcán O'Neill (also Lorcan O'Neill, or Lor): an Irish creative and commercial professional from Dublin who spent nearly nine years living and working in the Netherlands.

- Works on the commercial side of Arkintel, a Dutch technology company in AI.
- Over 13 years across design, communications, business and technology.
- Has written eight books, built apps and websites, and made music videos.
- Brands and organisations he has worked for and with: Arkintel, Heineken, Formula 1, UEFA, Just Eat, ATPI, Savvy Lab, HTM, Brandit, The Ocean Race. The site does not describe individual projects for these brands.
- Contact: lorcancreative@gmail.com

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.lorcan.space/): introduction
- [About](https://www.lorcan.space/about): his background in his own words
- [Experience](https://www.lorcan.space/experience): design, communications, business and technology, and his current role at Arkintel
- [Work](https://www.lorcan.space/work): the brands and organisations above
- [The Possibilities Studio](https://www.lorcan.space/studio): three independent brand concepts for fictional companies, clearly labelled as concepts, not client commissions:
  - [WADDEN](https://www.lorcan.space/studio/wadden): maritime robotics that inspect dikes and flood defences. Identity, stationery, campaigns, brochure, LinkedIn, exhibition stand, website.
  - [Kindling](https://www.lorcan.space/studio/kindling): small-business admin software. Identity, product introduction, newsletter, social, interface, posters, onboarding, website.
  - [RUNE](https://www.lorcan.space/studio/rune): premium audio. Identity, 3D product renders, packaging, launch campaign, editorial, website, billboard.
- [Thoughts](https://www.lorcan.space/thoughts): short notes on technology, AI, creativity and business
- [Contact](https://www.lorcan.space/contact): email
